title: When squaring makes a number smaller
claim: For every non-negative real number x, x squared is at least x.
context: A universal inequality. Integer-only tests miss the interval between zero and one.

title: A stable decay model, an unstable numerical step
claim: For the normalized decay equation y′ = −y with y = 1, one explicit Euler step never increases squared amplitude for any positive step h.
context: A numerical-model check, not a physical experiment. y_next = (1-h)y; initial y = 1. h is dimensionless.

title: A two-variable control case
claim: For all real x and y, the square of their sum is non-negative.
context: A control: finite search cannot prove a universal theorem even when no counterexample exists.
